newsitem.title: USA: Imperial Credit starts debt tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Credit starts debt tender offer.

text.p: Imperial Credit Industries Inc said Tuesday it has begun a cash tender offer for its $90 million, 9-3/4 percent senior notes, due 2004.

Imperial will pay $1,025 per senior note and an additional $15 per $1,000 principal amount of senior notes to holders who consent to indenture amendments. Imperial Credit also will pay accrued interest to, but not including, the payment date.
In order to receive the full payment of $1,040 per $1,000 principal amount, holders must tender their notes on or prior to the consent expiration date of 1700 EST on Jan. 9, 1997.
